recipe.optimizer: AdamW betas (0.9, 0.999), weight decay 0.05 on weight matrices and the patch-embedding kernel (not on biases, LayerNorms or pos_embed), grad-norm clip 1.0, bf16 autocast
recipe.lr: peak 0.001, linear warmup 200 steps, cosine decay to 0.01 x peak at step 4000
recipe.batch: 512 images per step (97 steps per epoch, the last partial batch of each epoch dropped)
recipe.data: CIFAR-10 training set (50,000 images, 10 classes), per-channel mean/std normalization, random crop 32x32 from the 4-pixel zero-padded image and random horizontal flip; no other augmentation, no label smoothing, no dropout
recipe.note: after your edit, training resumes from this step with the same optimizer state and the same sequence of batches (including the same augmentation draws), until total_steps
